title: check.py refuses a tracked path too long for a Windows clone's worker worktree
goal: check.py (or the gate a kb content commit runs) refuses a tracked path whose length, under a typical worker worktree prefix, passes the Windows path limit git hits without core.longpaths, so a long artifact path such as the 2025 STIG xccdf file (8a1e2de6) is caught on macOS at commit time instead of first failing a Windows landing; found by the SP-kjqdiudr close (BG-6sdkqlsu).

run: import sys;t=open('_tools/check.py',encoding='utf-8').read();ok='MAX_PATH' in t or 'longpaths' in t;print('check.py guards Windows path length:',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
